query: We are cutting the free trial from 14 days to 7. Before we ship, I want to know whether small business owners will push back.
expected_behavior: Recognises a reaction question and uses the skill without the user naming iMario
Calls imario:list_audiences and picks a small-business-owner audience that exists, or previews one with imario:create_audience and dry_run=true
Calls imario:estimate_study and asks the user before spending, because the user asked for a read, not for a study
Reports objections as counts and quotes, never as a prediction that the change will or will not work
